summary: charts/media/values.schema.json closes every level the chart defines, so storage.plex.subvolumeName and other unknown keys fail helm lint and render. Chart defaults, prd values and the deploy's --sets pass, and the prd render is unchanged apart from the deployment annotation (witnessed with Helm 4.3.0). A jsonschema pytest pins both sides; HelmCharts 6e5baa1 on phase/020-P5, kc project test green.
